title: Mac app: the Tally button in the session panel sits immediately to the right of the Dashboard button

requirements.text: In the Mac app's session panel, the Tally button is placed immediately right of the Dashboard button
requirements.check: eye: TJ relaunches the app and sees Tally right of Dashboard

requirements.text: Both buttons still open what they opened before the move
requirements.check: manual: click each button in the relaunched app; each opens its same view

text: Tally button moved to sit right after Dashboard in SessionBar (SessionsView.swift); built and installed to /Applications; relaunching with open -g; awaiting TJ's eye and click check

evidence: TJ eyed the relaunched app (PID 90585) after review R-N3EB7: 'yes love it' — Tally sits right of Dashboard
TJ answered R-N3EB7, which asked whether each button still opens what it did: 'yes love it'; button actions unchanged in the diff (route = .dashboard, openAssistant())

answers.observed: Diff moves one Button block (openAssistant) to directly after the Dashboard button in SessionBar, SessionsView.swift:71; build complete, app relaunched PID 90585; TJ eyed it: 'yes love it'
answers.cause: Position is set by HStack order before the Spacer; nothing else places it
answers.absence: No other Tally button in SessionBar; grep found the only openAssistant button there
answers.assumption: TJ's 'yes love it' covers the click check too, since the review asked both questions
answers.falsify: A narrow window crowding the usage meter, or a click on Tally/Dashboard opening the wrong view
